subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation inherit the complete models.providers.xai.request policy through useConfiguredRequest, rather than only the private-network boolean?
rationale: The canonical path avoids duplicate authorization logic, but it also activates configured headers and other transport settings on a security-sensitive image request surface; repository intent is needed to confirm that scope.

options.title: Approve canonical inheritance
options.body: Confirm that xAI image generation should consume the complete configured request policy, then merge after current-head real behavior proof is supplied.

options.title: Narrow the shared contract
options.body: Require a shared, explicitly bounded seam if xAI image generation should consume allowPrivateNetwork without inheriting the other configured request fields.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Keep the existing denial until maintainers decide which configured request fields are supported for media-generation providers.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical inheritance
recommendation.body: Confirm that xAI image generation should consume the complete configured request policy, then merge after current-head real behavior proof is supplied.
